## Checks

- [ ] I ran `npm run build` and `npm test` locally.
- [ ] I did **not** edit anything under `.github/` (CI, issue templates, this template) — those files are
      injected from upstream and local edits are overwritten.
- [ ] I understand this repository is a **published snapshot**: my change only takes effect once it is
      carried upstream, and the next release replaces the tree here.
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, DCO) — this project does not use a CLA.
- [ ] The change adds **no content source and no site implementation** (no site names, domains, site plugin
      ids, real content, scraped data, fixtures copied from a site, or site credentials anywhere — code,
      tests, docs).
- [ ] If it touches preview rendering: the preview still matches what the runtime and the device render, and
      the card-DSL verdict still comes from `lingshu-runtime` (no local copy).
- [ ] If it touches plugin-directory resolution or config: no hard-coded sibling paths, and the documented
      resolution order (`?dir=` → `LINGSHU_PLUGINS_DIR` / `--plugins-dir` → `<cwd>/plugins`) is unchanged.
- [ ] I did **not** set `LINGSHU_REQUIRE_PLUGIN_CORPUS` in CI or in a committed config (it belongs to the
      upstream repository, which has the corpus).
- [ ] Third-party material I added is MIT-compatible and listed in `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md`.
